entry.title: Product of the Day — Digital Electronic Cigarette
entry.content:
The Digital Electronic Cigarette simulates the act of smoking by releasing soothing vapor trails into thin air. As users inhale, their personal digital assistant integrates mood-enhancing ambient sounds and olfactory simulations tailored to their emotional state. Each puff adjusts nicotine levels according to self-reported stress thresholds.
Advanced biofeedback algorithms synchronize scent releases with individual's brainwave patterns, creating a unique sensory experience. Users can customize flavors via companion smartphone app, selecting from over 500 virtual aromas sourced from rare perfumes and obscure historical records.
Categories: normal, gadgets

entry.title: Product of the Day — Inflatable Sandblaster
entry.content:
The Inflatable Sandblaster is a portable, self-contained sand-holding vessel designed for rapid deployment into high-pressure blasting situations. Equipped with precision-engineered inflation valves, the unit inflates to four times its collapsed size within seconds, releasing precise jets of silica-rich particles at velocities up to 60 meters per second.
Adequately trained operators may utilize the Inflatable Sandblaster for surface preparation, graffiti removal, or as a makeshift percussion instrument during impromptu desert festivals.

entry.title: Product of the Day — Wearable Pizza
entry.content:
The Wearable Pizza is a fully functional, edible pizzeria integrated into a wearable garment. Made from a specially developed stretchy dough material, users can enjoy their favorite toppings while moving freely around town. The pizza's sauce-based adhesive ensures a secure fit during even the most vigorous activities.
As hunger strikes, simply rip open the pie-top zipper to reveal a steaming hot meal. And when finished, don't worry – the crumbs will magically compost into nutrient-rich fertilizer, leaving behind only satisfied satisfaction and perhaps a faint scent of oregano wafting through the air.
